issue_request: FHIR-31741 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction asking the Implementation Support module to replace the old Spark/Furore reference server entry with Firely Server, update the .NET library entry to Firely .NET SDK, and avoid duplicating reference implementation listings between the module page and downloads page.
initial_application: The Jira resolution says the request was already implemented through FHIR-26978 and HL7/fhir#1257. Git commit 265f01b0dd applied that related issue by replacing the Spark/Furore entry with Firely Server and replacing the old ewoutkramer/fhir-net-api entry with FirelyTeam/firely-net-sdk in source/implsupport-module.html. No separate FHIR-31741-tagged source commit was found.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2021-06-14 record the work group closing FHIR-31741 as a duplicate. Later source history moved these mutable server and library lists out of the core spec: FHIR-30088 changed the downloads reference implementations section to point to Confluence, and FHIR-31735 removed the local Implementation Support module tables in favor of the Public Test Servers and Open Source Implementations Confluence pages. The current build-scope source is referenced by source/hierarchy.xml and no longer contains the stale Spark or old .NET SDK rows.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source already satisfies the issue: the obsolete rows are gone, the module points readers to maintained Confluence lists, and downloads no longer carries the duplicated reference implementation table.
